List-I
List-II
(A) Compulsory Dissolution
(I) Partner becomes insane
(B) Dissolution by notice
(II) Death of a partner
(C) Dissolution by Court
(III) Business become illegal
(D) Dissolution on certain contingencies (IV) Partnership at will
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. (A) Compulsory Dissolution: Section 41 applies when the business becomes unlawful/illegal -> (III).
2. (B) Dissolution by notice: Section 43 applies specifically to a partnership at will -> (IV).
3. (C) Dissolution by Court: Section 44 applies when a partner becomes of unsound mind/insane -> (I).
4. (D) Dissolution on certain contingencies: Section 42 applies on the death of a partner -> (II).
5. Matching set: (A)-(III), (B)-(IV), (C)-(I), (D)-(II).
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
